#1 The Thurgens Dynasty

When the final heir of the prior matriarchal dynasty slipped into death?s embrace, the Council of Guilds gathered in solemn conclave to divine a successor worthy of the mountain's crown. For nearly two centuries, a regent bound in name alone held the reins of governance, his authority little more than a vessel for the Council's will. At last, beneath the molten heart of Dun herself, Theodora Th?rgens, was crowned Queen Matriarch amid iron hymns and ancestral fire. Her unflinching command brought decisive triumphs against the Kaivek Protectorate and the marauding Sunderhoof, heralding an age of golden fortune for the people of Dunzenkell.
